figures.finding: Directors are represented by the Hong Kong Film Directors' Guild (since 1988); it publishes no fee schedule. The government's production financing requires every director of a funded film to be a Hong Kong permanent resident.

sources.said: The Hong Kong Film Directors' Guild supports directors and promotes excellence in filmmaking, fostering growth in the Hong Kong film industry since 1988.
